title: Policy Weaver: modular policy evaluation engine and lightweight authz middleware for API/runtime/console
creator: Asha Nair
description: Build a compact, incremental policy evaluation engine (Policy Weaver) plus a lightweight authorization middleware that can be embedded in the API gateway, runtime request path, and the admin console. The goal is a single evaluation model that supports attribute-based rules, policy fragments, and fast explainability for deny/allow decisions. Must integrate with audit enrichment pipeline and SSO/SAML admin claims so console actions are fully traceable.
acceptance_criteria: A single binary/library that can evaluate policy bundles and return allow/deny decisions with explain metadata
Middleware adapters for API gateway, runtime-serving layer, and console that use the same evaluation API
Decision latency for simple allow/deny paths < 2ms p50 for in-memory cache hits
Audit events emitted for every decision with request_id, principal, policy_version, decision_reason
Support for SAML/SSO-propagated admin attributes (role, org, session_id) in evaluation
Canary rollout path for policy updates and deterministic dry‑run mode tied to console UX
technical_notes: Engine design: incremental evaluation with rule indexing by attribute hotspots and early-exit fast-paths
Policy format: JSON-LD like structure with typed attributes and fragment imports to enable per-team policy composition
Cache: two-layer cache (prefix-based for KV cache + ephemeral request-local cache) to keep p99 under SLO
Explainability: attach structured deny reasons and trace of matched rules up to a configured depth
Audit: decisions are enriched with policy_version, bundle_sha, and effective_attributes before shipping to audit sink
SSO: SAML assertion mapping will populate admin attributes via claims -> principal.attributes mapper in middleware

2026-02-28 - Liam: Reworked rule index to use attribute fingerprinting; cold-start improved to p50 ~3.1ms. Need to validate p99 under load.
2026-03-03 - PM review (R. Alvarez): Ensure audit schema includes policy_version and bundle_sha; must match compliance contract.
2026-03-06 - Security (M. Patel): SAML attributes mapping looks good; recommend threat modeling for attribute tampering during federation.
2026-03-10 - Design (E. Rossi): Console UX will show dry-run findings in the policy editor; add API for fetching last N decisions for a policy bundle
decisions: Adopt an opinionated policy fragment format to reduce evaluation complexity and make server-side composition deterministic
Expose a simple JSON decision envelope: {decision, reasons, policy_version, metadata} across middleware adapters
Emit audit events synchronously to local write-ahead-log before acking request to ensure durable forensic trail
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: policy churn causes evaluation regression. Mitigation: bundle validation CI and staged canary rollout with dry-run
Risk: SAML claim spoofing. Mitigation: enforce signed assertions + strict claim mappings and session binding checks
Risk: latency regressions on p99. Mitigation: two-layer caching, adaptive sampling for expensive rules, and watchdog circuit breaker
